column1: # clan_disc_open.tsv - the `Disciplines:` line of an OPEN trio, in words (SPEC I148d, V432b).
# An entry of CLANS with `choice` or `open` settles no trio, so the traits module cannot list
# three names for it: it carries the book's sentence instead, in both languages. T850 wrote
# Keskinen (one fixed, two picked - the trio the owner settled on 2026-08-25, not the book's);
# T970 added the seven clans (Ventrue Antitribu, Salubri (Wu Zao / Watchers), Angellis Ater, Maeghar, Panders, Caitiff, Children of Osiris).
# Header ASCII by convention; the DATA is not (V411b).
